blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in White Rock fell from 155 in June to 144 in September, and 37 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 24.0% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 600 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in White Rock?
White Rock also had 193 condos and townhomes listed and 20 sold in September, against 144 houses listed.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in White Rock?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 144 houses listed in White Rock. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is White Rock a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in White Rock had a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in White Rock from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 37 houses sold in White Rock over those 4 months, out of 240 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in White Rock?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
